svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outside 170 wide, 110 deep, 92 tall (walls and roof 3 mm), open at the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom; drip lid 200 x 140 x 3 on top. Print upside down, lid on the bed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Corner bosses: four 8 mm, 20 tall at the open edge, 7 mm in from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sides and ends; M3 heat-set inserts for the sensor floor screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hanging bosses: two 12 mm inside the roof, 50 each side of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 15 from the back face; M5 inserts put in from the top of the lid.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Roof glands: two 16.2 mm holes, 58 from the back face, 36 and 68 right

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of centre (under FieldNode's ports A and B).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Probe socket: 8.2 mm hole in the right wall, 45 from the back face,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back wall: four 7 mm bosses, 4 tall, M3 inserts, 76 apart across and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 43 apart up, for the front end standoffs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the floor fits the open edge all round; inserts square.
